Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the increased volume forecast and are pleased to support a 24-month contract, which allows us to improve our pricing. While we note your comments on delivery performance, we are actively optimizing our logistics to ensure the highest reliability.

We can accept your proposed payment terms of 45 days and offer a revised price of €5.53 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot consists of a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal to extend the contract term to 36 months, which provides valuable planning security for both of us. Based on this longer commitment, we are pleased to reduce our price to €5.40 per unit.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised proposal and the step you have taken. As part of our commitment to serving your needs, we can accommodate the requested 90-day payment terms; however, this extended period requires a price of €5.39 per unit to account for the associated financing costs. 

For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €5.39 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

We reiterate our request for a binding volume commitment, which remains the best avenue for further price improvements. Which volume can you commit to? We look forward to continuing our valued relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

decisions.tactician: Among the options, o5 (pay 45 d, 24 months) gives the lowest C of those listed. It offers the supplier the planning security it values without locking us into the 36-month term the engine (E0) proposes, and its C is slightly lower than E0's. The 12-month options cost far more. The large gap to the supplier's own sheet is a reasonable first move, since this was only its opening quote. Citing the rising forecasts plays to its need for volume, and the delivery record supports our push on price.

decisions.tactician: o6 has the same lowest-tier C as E0 (€303,437). It adds a 36-month term, which addresses its strong planning-security and idle-capacity needs at no cost to us. That makes a price move more likely than E0's bare restatement of 24 months. o8 is marginally cheaper for us but pays at 30 days and offers it nothing new. The 90-day options cost a higher price for a negligible C gain. Accepting €5.53 now would give up about €29k of C while the supplier is still moving about €0.25 per reply and is not at final offer. No new arguments are left to cite.

decisions.tactician: o2 keeps the 36-month term it values and has among the lowest C of the 36-month options (€309,949, tied with o1), well below the standing €325,109. The longer payment term is priced in by code, so the sheet is worth the same to it as E0 (-4.6%) while costing us slightly less than E0's €310,059. o8 is marginally cheaper for us but drops back to 24 months, giving up the planning security that drove its last concession. Accepting now would leave the remaining movement on the table, since at its recent pace the gap closes in about one reply. We have no new argument kinds left, so we cite none and stick to the volume and term framing it asked for, without promising volume beyond what the sheet fixes.
